title: Solar Milling Enterprises: Field Manual for Operators and Programme Staff
summary: Field manual covering solar milling system operation, preventive maintenance, enterprise management, and community engagement for solar milling operators and programme teams.
description: Designed as a hands-on manual for solar grain milling operators and the programme staff that support them, this document covers all aspects of solar milling enterprise operation. Content includes: solar system operation and daily checks; mill operation, cleaning, and safety protocols; preventive maintenance schedules for both the solar system and the mill; tariff collection and financial records; customer management and marketing for milling services; links to spare parts supply and technical support; and basic troubleshooting guides. The manual was developed from operational experience across five solar milling projects in Uganda and has been tested in training workshops with operators in Gulu and Soroti.
